task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the wger application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dashboard or main menu of the wger application is visible after the login screen.

task_completion.description: Agent filters the exercise database for Biceps brachii and Dumbbells.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The exercise search/filter interface showing 'Biceps brachii' selected in muscles and 'Dumbbell' selected in equipment.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a new training day named 'Pull Day' within the 'Push-Pull-Legs' routine.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new day titled 'Pull Day' appearing under the 'Push-Pull-Legs' routine structure.

task_completion.description: Agent adds a valid filtered exercise (Biceps/Dumbbell) to the 'Pull Day'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An exercise (e.g., Bicep Curls) listed under the 'Pull Day' section of the routine.

task_completion.description: Agent sets the exercise to 3 sets and 12 repetitions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The numbers '3' for sets and '12' for repetitions (reps) visible next to the exercise in the routine view.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than direct database manipulation or terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on buttons, and form filling within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed the search/filter rather than navigating directly to a known exercise URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the exercise list being filtered by the specific criteria (Biceps/Dumbbell).

integrity.description: The agent did not use pre-existing 'Pull Day' entries if they existed (though they shouldn't in a clean setup).
integrity.visual_evidence: The process of clicking 'Add day' or 'New day' and typing 'Pull Day' is visible.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Push-Pull-Legs' routine is pre-configured. The agent must find an exercise where equipment is 'Dumbbell' (ID 3) and muscle is 'Biceps brachii' (ID 1). The final state must show a 'Pull Day' with 3 sets and 12 reps for that specific exercise.
